hooks.command: if echo "${COMMAND}" | grep -qE 'rm -rf /|git push --force|git push -f|git reset --hard|git clean -f|git branch -D main|git branch -D master'; then echo '❌ 危险命令已拦截'; exit 1; fi

PostToolUse.description: 编辑 Java 后格式化+编译

hooks.command: if echo "${FILE_PATH}" | grep -q '\.java$'; then echo '🎨 格式化+编译...'; cd D:/code/java/spring-ai-parent && mvn spotless:apply compile -pl spring-ai-demo -q 2>&1 | tail -15; fi
if echo "${FILE_PATH}" | grep -q 'pom\.xml$'; then echo '📋 validate POM...'; cd D:/code/java/spring-ai-parent && mvn validate -q 2>&1 | tail -10; fi

PostToolUse.description: 编辑测试文件后自动运行测试

hooks.command: if echo "${FILE_PATH}" | grep -q 'src/test/.*\.java$'; then echo '🧪 运行单测...'; test_file="${FILE_PATH}"; class_name=$(basename "$test_file" .java); cd D:/code/java/spring-ai-parent && mvn test -pl spring-ai-demo -Dtest="$class_name" -q 2>&1 | tail -20; fi

Stop.description: 对话结束时展示 git diff

hooks.command: cd D:/code/java/spring-ai-parent && echo '=== Git Diff ===' && git diff --stat && echo '' && echo '=== Staged ===' && git diff --cached --stat
powershell -Command "Add-Type -AssemblyName System.Windows.Forms; [System.Windows.Forms.MessageBox]::Show('Claude Code 任务完成','✅ Done','OK','Information')"
